comment: One weapon per hull kind. Speeds are units per tick (256 units = 1 m, 20 ticks = 1 s): 3840 = 300 m/s. Range is in metres and decides how long a shot lives - life = range / speed, so a shot that misses simply runs out of flight rather than being deleted by a special case. hitsAir/hitsSurface classify by KIND, not by altitude: a Manta is air whether it is at cruise or on the deck.

manta.comment: Guided air-to-anything missiles. Four aboard, and no rearming until it is back on the deck, so a strike is a decision rather than a stream.

walrus.comment: A surface gun. It cannot elevate onto aircraft, which is what makes a lone Walrus ashore worth escorting.

lighter.comment: Unarmed. The logistics boat is a target, and protecting it is the point.

carrier.comment: Point defence, not an offensive battery: short-ranged, fast-firing, and effectively unlimited, because a ship that runs out of close-in defence is just a target. 1000 hull against 40-point missiles means a carrier survives 25 hits, which is more than one Manta strike carries.
